variants.name: Phase posters
variants.description: Each phase is one full-bleed flat colour with black ink, Unbounded headlines, a strict 24px grid, square corners and a single black bar button; vote is a 2x3 tile grid.

variants.name: Paper ledger
variants.description: Warm off-white paper with a thin coloured phase stripe; Fraunces display type and DM Mono labels; clues, votes and heart changes are set as ruled tables with numbered steps.
